diagnosis: The wording-based graph-role heuristic classified several direct single-relation questions as graph-suitable.
The fixed graph condition changed evidence more often for controls than for graph-role questions.
Risk-adaptive routing did not require graph_sufficient=true before selecting the graph route.
The LLM supplied ranked_snippet_ids directly; there was no deterministic graph-coverage selector.
Selective abstention was not applied after verification; all 32 answers were released despite non-supported claims.
decision: Retain Smoke V1 as a failed technical pilot. Do not use its condition comparisons as GraphRAG performance results. Run a graph-routing-only V2 stress test before any more answer generation.
